# Same underlying leading-garbage bug as too_restrictive_flagged_invalid_adapt_pi.txt,
# but with a *run* of two identical stale leading readings (seq=0,1, both
# weight_g=145.200) instead of one - previously wasn't trimmed at all
# (the old _first_plausible_index only ever rejected implausibly
# *negative* leading readings), so the real first sample (seq=2, 0.0g)
# looked like a mid-shot "disturbance" relative to that garbage-inflated
# 145.2g "peak", truncating the shot down to two samples and recording
# invalid_measurement/disturbance_left_too_few_samples. See
# flow_analysis.py's _first_plausible_index and
# tests/test_flow_analysis.py's own regression test for the fix - each
# garbage sample looks ahead to the first genuinely *different* value, so
# a plateau of repeated identical garbage doesn't mask itself.
